tutin: feels proud: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, lifts her chin with a proud confident smile and gently unrolls a small painted scroll in both hands to show a plum-blossom painting, small gold sparkles twinkle

stays proud in a slow loop: she glances down at her small painted scroll and back up with a proud smile, lifts her chin a little, the tiny gold sparkles twinkle; the scroll stays low in both hands, not held high
tinhtu: sweetly invites an honoured guest to her tea: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, holds up a small red-and-gold invitation card at chest height, gives a small gentle beckon with the other hand and a soft wink, a tiny pink heart appears
keeps inviting in a slow loop: she gives a small gentle beckon with curled fingers, winks softly with a sweet smile, the tiny pink heart floats; the card stays in her other hand; exactly two hands
tinhnghich: feels mischievous: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, covers her giggling mouth with one hand, her eyes curve with laughter, the other hand holds a small yellow paper toy snake still at chest height, tiny sparkle marks appear

keeps giggling in a slow loop: her shoulders shake gently with a hidden giggle behind her hand, her curved eyes squeeze with laughter, the small paper toy snake wiggles a little in her other hand; exactly two hands
hanghai: gets to work: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, rolls up her sleeves, writes steadily with a calligraphy brush on a small sheet of paper on the rim, the other hand holds the paper still, a small sweat drop
keeps working in a slow loop: she writes a few careful brush strokes on the small sheet, dips her head in concentration, the small sweat drop slides; the paper stays on the rim, no flying sheets
chuyentam: becomes absorbed: she leans a little forward over the gold rim holding an open book close in both hands, her eyes fix down on the page, calm and focused, a tiny hourglass beside her
stays absorbed in a slow loop: her eyes follow the lines down the page, she turns one page slowly with her fingers, stays calm and focused; the tiny hourglass sand trickles
hungkhoi: feels inspired: she leans a little forward over the gold rim, lifts a calligraphy brush near her shoulder, one small purple ink swirl curls through the air with sparkles, her eyes glow with a joyful smile, the other hand rests on the rim

stays inspired in a slow loop: she gives the brush a small graceful flick near her shoulder, the small purple ink swirl curls softly with sparkles, she smiles with glowing eyes; the other hand stays on the rim, no sweeping arm
